dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid white pixel clusters with minimal internal gradient, concentrated mostly in the anterior dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most distinct dorsal annuli form a trapezoidal spatial relationship with the longest side parallel to the dorsal curve.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, elongated, light-colored linear mark is visible on the posterior section, appearing as a physical scar or healed trauma distinct from the natural skin pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive chain-like interlocking of multiple annuli along the mid-dorsal region, creating a continuous network of shared high-intensity boundaries.
